quests.title: Divine Ingenuity: Collector's Chapter

dialogue.t: Why is it in Mondstadt this time...
Traveler? What a coincidence! I didn't expect you to be here...
As for the present situation... Well, just look at this door next to me. I suppose you already understand.

dialogue.sit: So a Domain of that kind has appeared again?
Is this the same sort of Domain as that other one you were investigating?

dialogue.t: That's right. Thanks to your help in investigating that other Domain, we were able to obtain all manner of important data.
However, there wasn't any way of getting more useful information on that Domain from the outside. Not for lack of trying by the Guild, but still.
As such, we were getting ready to send more people into it. We'd even called people from other Guilds in... but then it vanished.
And that was the last we heard of it until it showed up today in Mondstadt. I only got here in time thanks to timely notice from our colleagues in Mondstadt.
Of course. Why would I fall back with the prize before me?
The rules of this Domain haven't changed a great deal. It still creates various things based on the imaginations of those who enter it.
But as we plumbed its depths, we found that this Domain is now able to create certain "enemies."
They would attack us, and we actually felt real pain when they did.
How should I put this... It was no different from a real battle, which the other adventurers found rather interesting.
However, some of them conjured foes they could not beat, and wound up needing help to beat them...
*cough* But never mind that. If you're willing, Traveler, could you explore this Domain together with us once again?

dialogue.sit: It won't be too dangerous, will it...

dialogue.t: Hahaha, wonderful, then! With your help, I'm sure that progress will be smooth indeed.

quests.description: You once again encounter Honglang in the outskirts of Mondstadt. He appears to still be investigating that strange Domain…
